sourceNote: Static offline reference using official JR East, Tokyo Metro, Toei Subway, Enoshima Electric Railway, and current Oct 2026 JR East Narita Express information. Kamakura, Yokohama, west-Tokyo Chuo, and airport itinerary corridors were rechecked against official operator information on 2026-09-26. Not live timetable data.
notice: Offline orientation guide only. Train destinations, through-services, stopping patterns, platforms, delays and temporary changes can vary. For Kamakura, confirm the current JR destination before boarding and use current station signs; Enoden is represented as a separate local line.

lines.name: Yamanote Line
lines.summary: Tokyo's famous JR loop linking Shinjuku, Shibuya, Shinagawa, Tokyo, Ueno and Ikebukuro.
lines.serviceNote: For the Yamanote loop, Sakura uses JR East's clockwise/counterclockwise orientation terms. Always confirm the current platform sign and destination before boarding.

lines.name: Chuo Line (Rapid) · Tokyo–Kokubunji
lines.summary: Fast east-west JR corridor from Tokyo through Shinjuku, Kichijoji and Mitaka to Musashi-Koganei and Kokubunji.
lines.serviceNote: This guide shows station order. Rapid stopping patterns can vary by train and day.

stations.name: Musashi-Koganei
stations.nearby: Koganei Park · Edo-Tokyo Open Air Museum bus access

lines.name: Keihin-Tohoku・Negishi Line · Tokyo–Ishikawacho
lines.summary: Useful north-south JR corridor through central Tokyo and Yokohama, continuing on the Negishi Line to Sakuragicho, Kannai and Ishikawacho.
lines.serviceNote: Some daytime services operate as Rapid through central Tokyo. Always check the train display.

lines.name: Yokosuka Line · Tokyo–Kamakura
lines.summary: Direct JR corridor from Tokyo and Shinagawa through Yokohama to Kita-Kamakura and Kamakura.
lines.serviceNote: Static station-order guide. JR East services and through-running can vary; confirm the current destination and platform before boarding.

lines.name: Shonan-Shinjuku Line · Ikebukuro–Kamakura
lines.summary: Useful JR day-trip corridor from Ikebukuro, Shinjuku and Shibuya toward Yokohama, Kita-Kamakura and Kamakura.
lines.serviceNote: Not every southbound Shonan-Shinjuku train continues to Kamakura or Zushi. Sakura shows the verified corridor, not a live timetable—check the destination display before boarding.

lines.name: Narita Express · Shinjuku–Narita Airport
lines.summary: Direct limited-express airport service used by the October itinerary between Shinjuku and Narita Airport Terminal 2・3.
lines.serviceNote: Reserved-seat limited express. This itinerary service entry keeps the direct Shinjuku ↔ Narita Airport T2・3 leg available offline without treating N’EX as an ordinary Tokyo commuter line. Confirm the current train number, platform and stopping pattern on the travel day.

lines.name: Enoden Line · Fujisawa–Kamakura
lines.summary: Scenic local line linking Fujisawa, Enoshima, Kamakura-Koko-Mae, Hase and Kamakura.
lines.serviceNote: Static Enoden station order. This is ideal for Hase, the Great Buddha, Hasedera, seaside stops and Enoshima; confirm current service information at the station.
